product_overview: Maju Bersama POS & Accounting Backend is a Laravel-based multi-store retail backend for branch-aware product and inventory management, POS checkout, stock transfers, and real-time accounting journals. It supports secure token-based access and CRUD APIs for managing branches, catalog data, sales, and financial records.
core_goals: Provide secure authentication and branch-aware user context for all protected operations
Enable multi-branch management for stores, products, categories, and inventory visibility
Support barcode-based product lookup and catalog CRUD for POS and admin workflows
Allow inter-branch stock transfer creation and tracking
Process POS checkout transactions with inventory deduction and receipt/journal generation
Record double-entry accounting journals for real-time ledger updates

features.name: Authentication & Authorization
features.description: Allows users to log in, receive a Sanctum token, access their profile and branch context, and revoke their session when done.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with Sanctum bearer token and user role -> GET /api/user with bearer token -> Receive 200 with authenticated user profile and assigned branch
POST /api/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> GET /api/user without a token -> Receive 401 authentication required error
POST /api/logout with a valid bearer token -> Receive 200 confirming token revocation -> GET /api/user with the revoked token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error

features.name: Branch Management
features.description: Lets authorized users view, create, update, and delete store branches for a multi-store setup.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with bearer token -> GET /api/branches with bearer token -> Receive 200 with active branch list -> POST /api/branches with valid branch data -> Receive 201 with new branch details -> GET /api/branches/{branch} -> Receive 200 with branch metadata
POST /api/login with non-admin credentials -> Receive 200 with bearer token -> POST /api/branches with unauthorized role -> Receive 403 forbidden error
GET /api/branches without authentication -> Receive 401 authentication required error -> POST /api/branches without authentication -> Receive 401 authentication required error

features.name: Products Management
features.description: Provides branch-scoped product catalog access, barcode lookup for POS, and full CRUD for product records.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with bearer token -> GET /api/products with bearer token -> Receive 200 with products scoped to current branch and stock levels -> GET /api/products/barcode/{barcode} -> Receive 200 with matching product details -> POST /api/products with valid product payload -> Receive 201 with created product

POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with bearer token -> PUT /api/products/{product} with updated pricing and SKU -> Receive 200 with updated product details -> DELETE /api/products/{product} -> Receive 200 with deletion confirmation

GET /api/products/barcode/{barcode} with an unknown barcode and valid token -> Receive 404 product not found error -> PUT /api/products/{product} with invalid product id -> Receive 404 not found error
GET /api/products without authentication -> Receive 401 authentication required error -> POST /api/products without authentication -> Receive 401 authentication required error

features.name: Categories Management
features.description: Supports category tree retrieval and category CRUD for organizing products.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with bearer token -> GET /api/categories with bearer token -> Receive 200 with category tree -> POST /api/categories with valid category data -> Receive 201 with created category -> GET /api/categories/{category} -> Receive 200 with category details

POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with bearer token -> PUT /api/categories/{category} with updated category attributes -> Receive 200 with updated category details -> DELETE /api/categories/{category} -> Receive 200 with deletion confirmation
POST /api/categories without authentication -> Receive 401 authentication required error -> GET /api/categories without authentication -> Receive 401 authentication required error

features.name: Stock Transfer
features.description: Enables creation and tracking of inventory movements between branches, including transfer manifests and status inspection.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with bearer token -> GET /api/stock-transfers with bearer token -> Receive 200 with stock transfer list -> POST /api/stock-transfers with valid source branch, destination branch, and item quantities -> Receive 201 with transfer request details -> GET /api/stock-transfers/{stockTransfer} -> Receive 200 with transfer manifest and status
POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with bearer token -> POST /api/stock-transfers with insufficient stock or invalid branch references -> Receive 422 validation error

GET /api/stock-transfers without authentication -> Receive 401 authentication required error -> GET /api/stock-transfers/{stockTransfer} without authentication -> Receive 401 authentication required error

features.name: Point of Sale Checkout
features.description: Processes a cart sale transaction, validates inventory, calculates totals, decrements stock, and creates the sales record and accounting impact.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with bearer token -> POST /api/checkout with cart items and payment method -> Receive 200 with invoice/receipt details and successful stock deduction
POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with bearer token -> POST /api/checkout with items exceeding available inventory -> Receive 422 inventory validation error
POST /api/checkout without authentication -> Receive 401 authentication required error

features.name: Accounting Journals
features.description: Creates double-entry journal records for financial transactions and ledger updates.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with bearer token -> POST /api/journals with balanced debit and credit entries -> Receive 201 with journal record confirmation
POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with bearer token -> POST /api/journals with unbalanced debit and credit totals -> Receive 422 validation error
POST /api/journals without authentication -> Receive 401 authentication required error
